summary.zh-CN: 用 page、offset、cursor 或 next URL 四种策略有界读取集合。
summary.en: Boundedly read a collection with page, offset, cursor or next-URL pagination.

details.zh-CN: 提供页数、记录数、总字节和总时限上限，按整页提交记录，并检测重复 cursor、重复 next URL、不增长 offset 与无记录推进。
details.en: Enforces page, record, byte and total-deadline limits, commits only whole pages, and detects repeated cursors, repeated next URLs, non-growing offsets and no record progress.

input_summary.zh-CN: 入口 URL、分页策略、items 指针、下一页字段和请求参数名。
input_summary.en: Entry URL, pagination strategy, items pointer, continuation field and request parameter names.

output_summary.zh-CN: 有界 records、页数、记录数、partial，以及仅 page/offset 可直接恢复的 checkpoint。
output_summary.en: Bounded records, page and record counts, partial state, and checkpoints directly resumable only for page/offset strategies.

risk.zh-CN: next URL 默认只允许同协议同主机；该检查不构成平台级 SSRF 防线。
risk.en: Next URLs remain same-scheme and same-host by default; this check is not a platform SSRF boundary.

install_notes.zh-CN: 无需额外依赖；此 Variant 仅使用对应 Runtime 的标准库。复制后仍需选择兼容 Worker，并通过 Credential Binding 配置真实凭据。
install_notes.en: No extra dependency is required; this Variant uses only its Runtime standard library. After copying, select a compatible Worker and configure real credentials through Credential Binding.

query_auth.description: Optional API key query injection resolved from Credential Binding; credential-like names are forbidden in direct URLs and pagination parameter names.

input_contract.credential_name_policy: credential-like query and header names are fail-closed; query credentials require query_auth and header credentials require DLR-Auth

output_contract.records_order: source order; only complete source pages are committed
output_contract.record_cap_behavior: a page larger than the remaining max_records budget is omitted in full
output_contract.byte_cap_behavior: transport bytes count only successful requests; scrubbed records are also checked as one whole page before commit

checkpoint_contract.page: overlay strategy and start_page on the original input to resume at the first uncommitted page
checkpoint_contract.offset: overlay strategy and start_offset on the original input to resume at the first uncommitted offset
checkpoint_contract.cursor: null on partial output because opaque continuations are not emitted or claimed as resumable
checkpoint_contract.next-url: null on partial output because signed or credential-bearing URLs are not emitted or claimed as resumable

runtime_guidance.zh-CN: 模板复制后默认停止。为 python 选择兼容 Worker；Secret 键仅通过 Credential Binding 提供：HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN、HTTP_API_KEY。凭据类 query/header 名称默认拒绝；Query API Key 只能通过 query_auth.secret_binding 注入，Header 凭据只能通过 DLR-Auth 注入。记录会在脱敏后的整页输出通过 max_bytes 预算后才原子提交；超限时 page/offset checkpoint 指向当前未提交边界，cursor/next-url checkpoint 保持 null。页数只统计已成功请求。仅对安全可重试的 GET 使用有界退避。
runtime_guidance.en: The copied template is stopped by default. Select a compatible python Worker. Secret keys are supplied only through Credential Binding: HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN and HTTP_API_KEY. Credential-like query and header names are rejected by default; query API keys must use query_auth.secret_binding and header credentials must use DLR-Auth. A scrubbed page is committed atomically only after its full records output fits max_bytes; on overflow, page/offset checkpoints remain at the current uncommitted boundary and cursor/next-url checkpoints remain null. Page counts include successful requests only. Use bounded backoff only for safely retryable GET requests.
